content.value_statement: Backend query code can create security gaps and slow applications. This skill guides safer query structure, ORM usage, indexing, caching, and transactions.
actual_capabilities: Guides use of parameterized queries to reduce SQL injection risk.
Highlights eager loading patterns to avoid N+1 query problems.
Recommends filtering, sorting, pagination, and selected column practices.
Supports review of joins, related data access, and repository methods.
Suggests index, timeout, caching, and monitoring considerations.
Promotes transaction handling for related database operations.
limitations: It provides guidance only and does not execute database queries.
It needs project schema, ORM, and performance context from the user.
It does not include the referenced external standards file.
It cannot verify production performance without logs or metrics.

use_cases.title: Review Repository Queries
use_cases.description: Check repository methods for parameter safety, selected columns, pagination, and maintainable data access.

use_cases.title: Fix Slow Endpoints
use_cases.description: Identify N+1 loading, missing indexes, expensive joins, and caching opportunities in service queries.

use_cases.title: Design Safe Transactions
use_cases.description: Plan transaction boundaries, rollback behavior, timeouts, and error handling for related database changes.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Simple Query
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this database query for safe parameters, selected columns, and clear filtering. Explain each change in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Fix N+1 Loading
prompt_templates.prompt: Find N+1 query risks in this repository method. Recommend eager loading and pagination changes that match the existing ORM.

prompt_templates.title: Design Transaction Handling
prompt_templates.prompt: Design transaction handling for these related database updates. Include rollback behavior, timeout choices, and error handling boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Query Layer Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this service query layer for injection risk, slow joins, missing indexes, caching candidates, and monitoring points.

output_examples.input: A user list endpoint loads profiles one at a time and returns every column.
output: Recommended eager loading and selected columns.
Added pagination, sorting limits, and an index review.

output_examples.input: A payment update writes several related records without a transaction.
output: Defined one transaction boundary for all related writes.
Recommended rollback handling for partial failures.
Added timeout and retry guidance for database errors.

best_practices: Share the ORM, schema shape, and expected query volume before asking for recommendations.
Ask for parameterized alternatives when reviewing raw SQL or dynamic filters.
Validate suggested indexes and caching changes against real workload metrics.
anti_patterns: Do not paste production secrets, credentials, or customer data into prompts.
Do not ask for broad rewrites without schema, constraints, or performance symptoms.
Do not accept caching recommendations without freshness and invalidation requirements.

faq.question: Does this skill write SQL directly?
faq.answer: It can guide SQL structure, but it mainly reviews and improves database query patterns.

faq.question: Can it help with ORMs?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers ORM query methods, eager loading, repositories, pagination, and related data access.

faq.question: Does it prevent SQL injection automatically?
faq.answer: No. It recommends safer parameterized patterns, but developers must implement and test them.

faq.question: Can it diagnose slow production queries?
faq.answer: It can suggest likely causes when you provide query plans, logs, schema details, or metrics.

faq.question: Is the skill self-contained?
faq.answer: Not fully. The source references an external standards file outside the packaged skill.

faq.question: Which tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks it compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
